verdict.rationale: UKVI runs online digital services, including eVisas, online applications, a visa-finder tool and a processing-time checker, so AI-generated insights inside the product is a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from a user's data. The visa-finder tool is an adjacent guidance feature and is not evidenced as AI-driven or based on personal data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
